g.text: Actual induced circuit; MNs, Ia/Ib-labelled cells, Ia interneurons, and Renshaw cells
Physical Ia adapters enter the Ia-IN cells in this source, rather than the separate
Ia-labelled cells. Full physical input polynomials/units accompany the export.
Double ring: spiking population (cell count shown). Open triangle: excitatory type;
filled circle: inhibitory. Current = g(Erev − Vpost).
